# Renaming a user in sesam.yml, keeping the key, cannot be applied: the new user
# is told before the old one is killed, and keys are unique per user. apply
# names the command that does it.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init'

exec sed -i 's/bob/robert/g' sesam.yml
! exec sesam config apply
stderr 'already has recipient'
stderr 'sesam user rename bob robert'
